name: Supplier Sales Agent
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
    supplier_sales_partner AS "Supplier Sales Partner:Link/Sales Partner:150",
    amount_eligible_for_commission AS "Amount Eligible for Commission:Currency:120",
    supplier_sales_partner_commission AS "Supplier Commission:Currency:120",
    supplier_sales_partner_commission_rate AS "Supplier Commission Rate:Percent:80"
FROM
    `tabSales Invoice`
WHERE
    docstatus = 1
    AND IFNULL(amount_eligible_for_commission, 0) > 0
    AND IFNULL(supplier_sales_partner_commission, 0) > 0
ORDER BY
    name DESC
